title: Therapeutic factors in sexual group therapy
summary: The study takes place within the framework of the prevention project "Kein Täter werden" at the location in Ulm. It is to be researched which therapeutic factors came into play within the weekly group therapy for pedophile and hebephile clients. For this purpose, former participants of the group therapy will be interviewed. The overall aim of the research project is to improve the group therapy strategy by focusing on particularly relevant therapeutic factors.

interventions.name: The former participants of the group therapy will be asked retrospectively by means of qualitative methods how the therapy worked for them (and which therapeutic factors came into play).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Pedophile or hebephile sexual preference, participation in main therapy group of the project "Kein Täter werden" at the location in Ulm.
Exclusion criteria:
Mental retardation.
